claim_ceiling: Declarative synthetic scenario definitions only. They are not executable byte vectors, provider payloads, adapter results, source-authenticity evidence, legal assessments, or field interoperability results.

cases.source_claim: Provider-issued berth identifier bound to the exact provider and facility maps to the same berth subject.
cases.target_attempt: Target retains issuer, facility, resource type and identifier value.
cases.setup: Positive control for exact resource identity preservation.
cases.negative_control: A bare identifier without issuer or resource type must not pass.

cases.source_claim: Small craft has a valid national registry identifier but no IMO number.
cases.target_attempt: Target retains the national scheme, issuer and vessel subject without requiring an IMO number.
cases.setup: Valid scheme-qualified small-craft identity remains representable.
cases.negative_control: Do not synthesize an IMO number.

cases.source_claim: A UN/LOCODE identifies a port or trade location.
cases.target_attempt: Target attempts to bind that code to one specific marina berth.
cases.setup: Port-level place identity is not a berth identity.
cases.negative_control: No inferred facility or slip specificity.

cases.source_claim: An IMO company or registered-owner identifier is supplied for an organization.
cases.target_attempt: Target attempts to treat it as a vessel identifier.
cases.setup: Subject type mismatch must be rejected.
cases.negative_control: Do not coerce organization subject to vessel subject.

cases.source_claim: A vessel display name and call sign are supplied without a verified issuer-scoped identifier.
cases.target_attempt: Target attempts to merge records as one immutable vessel.
cases.setup: Names and call signs alone do not establish universal immutable identity.
cases.negative_control: Do not use fuzzy matching to manufacture identity.

cases.source_claim: An issuer-scoped identifier is reassigned under the issuing scheme's lifecycle rules.
cases.target_attempt: Target reuses the current subject binding for a historical event.
cases.setup: Historical and current subject bindings must remain distinct.
cases.negative_control: Preserve temporal identifier lineage.

cases.source_claim: Provider emits a signed reservation.updated notification.
cases.target_attempt: Target projects it as fresh live availability.
cases.setup: Webhook authenticity does not turn notification into live availability.
cases.negative_control: Require separate current availability evidence.

cases.source_claim: Provider emits an offer with conditions and expiry.
cases.target_attempt: Target projects the offer as a provider commitment.
cases.setup: Offer and commitment are different operational stages.
cases.negative_control: No offer-to-confirmed transition.

cases.source_claim: Provider emits a provider commitment for a specific resource and interval.
cases.target_attempt: Target preserves the commitment and its source authority without upgrading it to legal permission or physical fulfilment.
cases.setup: Positive control for correctly scoped provider commitment.
cases.negative_control: No government or physical-truth promotion.

cases.source_claim: Private StayManifest is presented as proof of a Maritime Single Window filing or clearance.
cases.target_attempt: Target claims a government submission or clearance.
cases.setup: Private coordination artifacts cannot impersonate public authority records.
cases.negative_control: Separate submission, acknowledgement, acceptance and clearance.

cases.source_claim: IHO S-131 harbour/service feature is present in a pinned product dataset.
cases.target_attempt: Target projects it as current reservable berth inventory.
cases.setup: Harbour infrastructure information is not provider live inventory.
cases.negative_control: Require provider-owned availability and commitment.

cases.source_claim: IHO S-127 traffic-management feature is present.
cases.target_attempt: Target projects it as port-entry clearance or berth booking authority.
cases.setup: Traffic-management information cannot confer clearance or booking authority.
cases.negative_control: Preserve product claim ceiling.

cases.source_claim: A provider availability snapshot is outside its validity interval.
cases.target_attempt: Target marks the resource available now.
cases.setup: Stale snapshot cannot become current availability.
cases.negative_control: Do not substitute receipt time for source currentness.

cases.source_claim: A webhook is delivered now but its source event time is old.
cases.target_attempt: Target uses delivery time as the availability observation time.
cases.setup: Delivery time and event/source time are distinct.
cases.negative_control: Preserve each timestamp role.

cases.source_claim: Two source events conflict on reservation state and source revision order is unknown.
cases.target_attempt: Target uses last arrival wins and reports confirmed.
cases.setup: Arrival order cannot substitute for source revision semantics.
cases.negative_control: Retain conflict pending source reconciliation.

cases.source_claim: Source uses an enum value unknown to the adapter version.
cases.target_attempt: Target defaults the unknown value to available.
cases.setup: Unknown source values must not be converted into positive states.
cases.negative_control: Preserve opaque value or quarantine.

cases.source_claim: Source omits a field because it was not supplied.
cases.target_attempt: Target interprets omission as an explicit false or zero.
cases.setup: Absence must remain distinct from explicit false/zero.
cases.negative_control: No implicit default.

cases.source_claim: Source distinguishes absent, explicit null, empty string and empty array.
cases.target_attempt: Target normalizes all four to one empty value.
cases.setup: Distinct source states must not be collapsed where decision-relevant.
cases.negative_control: Retain null/absence/cardinality semantics.

cases.source_claim: Source marks a capacity value as partial or estimated.
cases.target_attempt: Target emits an exact complete capacity assertion.
cases.setup: Completeness and uncertainty cannot be strengthened.
cases.negative_control: Preserve estimate/coverage metadata.

cases.source_claim: Same logical provider event is delivered repeatedly with distinct delivery attempts.
cases.target_attempt: Target creates multiple independent logical reservation changes.
cases.setup: Delivery attempt identity and logical event identity must remain distinct.
cases.negative_control: Deduplication requires provider-defined identity semantics.

cases.source_claim: Pinned ISO 4217 metadata identifies a currency with zero minor-unit exponent.
cases.target_attempt: Target assumes two decimal places.
cases.setup: Currency exponent must come from exact metadata.
cases.negative_control: No universal two-decimal assumption.

cases.source_claim: Pinned ISO 4217 metadata identifies a currency with three minor-unit exponent.
cases.target_attempt: Target assumes two decimal places.
cases.setup: Currency exponent must come from exact metadata.
cases.negative_control: No universal two-decimal assumption.

cases.source_claim: Historical quote references a dated currency metadata artifact.
cases.target_attempt: Target reinterprets the amount using a newer metadata snapshot.
cases.setup: Historical amount meaning must remain bound to effective metadata.
cases.negative_control: No mutable-latest reinterpretation.

cases.source_claim: Same monetary amount is rendered under two locales with different grouping and decimal separators.
cases.target_attempt: Target canonical monetary amount changes when locale changes.
cases.setup: Locale formatting is presentation only.
cases.negative_control: Canonical value and metadata binding remain unchanged.

cases.source_claim: Quote currency differs from settlement currency and no FX evidence is supplied.
cases.target_attempt: Target silently converts using an unstated rate.
cases.setup: Quote and settlement currencies are distinct; conversion requires evidence.
cases.negative_control: No implicit FX.

cases.source_claim: FX rate has declared base, quote, direction, timestamp, source and precision.
cases.target_attempt: Target performs the conversion using the exact declared direction and records rounding.
cases.setup: Positive control for evidence-bound FX derivation.
cases.negative_control: Inverse-rate mutation must fail.

cases.source_claim: Refund request was accepted but no payment-rail refund execution/finality evidence exists.
cases.target_attempt: Target reports refund settled or final.
cases.setup: A refund request or signed provider message is not refund finality.
cases.negative_control: Keep request, attempt, effect and finality separate.

cases.source_claim: Tax-inclusive source amount is mapped to tax-exclusive target line item without tax evidence.
cases.target_attempt: Target reports the net amount as authoritative.
cases.setup: Tax semantics cannot be inferred from the numeric amount alone.
cases.negative_control: Require source tax/fee meaning and reviewed mapping.

cases.source_claim: Source quantity is in power units (W); target field expects energy (Wh).
cases.target_attempt: Target copies the numeric value and changes only the unit label.
cases.setup: Power and energy are different dimensions.
cases.negative_control: Require a valid time integral and its provenance.

cases.source_claim: Source length is in feet; target requires metres and declares exact conversion, precision and rounding.
cases.target_attempt: Target retains source quantity and conversion lineage and produces the declared result.
cases.setup: Positive control for a correctly bounded unit conversion.
cases.negative_control: Changing precision must alter the derived representation but not erase source value.

cases.source_claim: Source mass is mapped to waste volume without density or material-specific evidence.
cases.target_attempt: Target emits a volume value as exact.
cases.setup: Mass-to-volume needs additional evidence and assumptions.
cases.negative_control: No dimension laundering.

cases.source_claim: Source speed in knots is converted to kilometres per hour using a pinned conversion implementation.
cases.target_attempt: Target preserves source value/unit, target value/unit, transform digest and rounding.
cases.setup: Positive control for a typed unit transform.
cases.negative_control: A unit label change without numeric transform must fail.

cases.source_claim: A local deadline is a date-only value in the provider's locale and zone context.
cases.target_attempt: Target converts it to midnight UTC.
cases.setup: Date-only values are not instants.
cases.negative_control: Preserve calendar date and applicable local policy context.

cases.source_claim: A local arrival time falls in a daylight-saving fold and no disambiguation evidence exists.
cases.target_attempt: Target silently selects the earlier offset.
cases.setup: Fold ambiguity requires an explicit disposition.
cases.negative_control: No silent fold resolution.

cases.source_claim: A local arrival time falls in a daylight-saving gap.
cases.target_attempt: Target silently shifts it to the next valid instant.
cases.setup: Gap handling is a policy decision and must be explicit.
cases.negative_control: No silent gap repair.

cases.source_claim: A timestamp uses a quarter-hour UTC offset and a named IANA zone.
cases.target_attempt: Target rounds the offset to the nearest half-hour.
cases.setup: Unusual offsets must be preserved exactly.
cases.negative_control: No offset truncation or rounding.

cases.source_claim: A future local schedule was interpreted under a pinned tzdb version; tzdb later changes.
cases.target_attempt: Target rewrites the historical source lexeme and original UTC interpretation without preserving the old evidence.
cases.setup: Historical evidence is immutable; future schedule evaluation may be requalified.
cases.negative_control: Preserve prior tzdb binding and new evaluation separately.

cases.source_claim: Source contains Arabic right-to-left text adjacent to Latin identifiers and digits.
cases.target_attempt: Target reorders or alters the source string during canonical semantic mapping.
cases.setup: Display direction must not rewrite source evidence or identifier bytes.
cases.negative_control: Preserve exact source text and separate display metadata.

cases.source_claim: Two source strings are canonically equivalent Unicode sequences but are not byte-identical.
cases.target_attempt: Target silently rewrites signed source bytes during evidence preservation.
cases.setup: Unicode normalization policy must be explicit and source bytes retained.
cases.negative_control: Display normalization cannot mutate signed evidence.

cases.source_claim: Machine translation of a cancellation clause has no competent human review.
cases.target_attempt: Target promotes the translation to authoritative provider terms.
cases.setup: Translation is a derived artifact, not automatically authoritative.
cases.negative_control: Preserve source language and translation review status.

cases.source_claim: Provider source language differs from the user's preferred language and no reviewed translation exists.
cases.target_attempt: Target silently falls back and records the user as having accepted the terms.
cases.setup: Fallback and comprehension are distinct from authoritative terms and consent.
cases.negative_control: No silent language fallback for material terms.

cases.source_claim: A canonical target assertion is created from a provider source event and a named deterministic transform.
cases.target_attempt: Target retains source event, source profile pin, transform version and output digest.
cases.setup: Positive control for complete lineage.
cases.negative_control: Removing any required reference makes the dependent claim NotEvaluable.

cases.source_claim: A source event is corrected by a later provider event.
cases.target_attempt: Target overwrites the old event instead of adding a supersession link.
cases.setup: Correction must not erase historical evidence.
cases.negative_control: Retain prior assertion and correction relationship.

cases.source_claim: Source event includes customer contact fields outside the approved projection purpose.
cases.target_attempt: Target emits those fields to a public provider directory.
cases.setup: Adapter mapping must not expand disclosure purpose.
cases.negative_control: Zero unauthorized field disclosure.

cases.source_claim: A source identifier is hashed before publication but the downstream purpose is not authorized.
cases.target_attempt: Target treats hashing as sufficient authority to disclose and reuse it.
cases.setup: Pseudonymization does not itself authorize processing or disclosure.
cases.negative_control: Purpose and recognition remain independently required.

cases.source_claim: A mapping drops the source timezone and claims exact round-trip recovery.
cases.target_attempt: Target declares exact_round_trip despite the lost zone information.
cases.setup: A lost dimension cannot be exactly reconstructed from a target that no longer carries it.
cases.negative_control: Require lossy declaration and prohibit unsupported reconstruction.

cases.source_claim: A mapping aggregates several source records and declares which record-level distinctions are lost.
cases.target_attempt: Target labels the operation lossy_declared and keeps references to all source records.
cases.setup: Explicit bounded loss can be represented without pretending it is reversible.
cases.negative_control: Dependent claims requiring record distinctions remain unavailable.

cases.source_claim: Source profile digest changes while adapter continues to claim the earlier profile version.
cases.target_attempt: Target accepts the new source under the old pinned mapping without requalification.
cases.setup: Profile version and digest are part of the mapping identity.
cases.negative_control: No silent latest alias.

cases.source_claim: Two source payloads differ only in object-member ordering and insignificant whitespace under the declared source format.
cases.target_attempt: Target semantic projection differs between the two inputs.
cases.setup: Representation-only changes must not create semantic drift.
cases.negative_control: Metamorphic pair must have equivalent target meaning.

cases.source_claim: A deterministic adapter is applied twice to its own declared canonical projection.
cases.target_attempt: Second application introduces new defaults, drops provenance or changes authority stage.
cases.setup: Repeated application must not accumulate semantic drift.
cases.negative_control: Idempotence is scoped to the declared projection/equivalence relation.
